1: // Minimal endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas element with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
9: 
10:   // Player
11:   const player = {
12:     w: 30,
13:     h: 30,
14:     x: W / 2 - 15,
15:     y: H - 30,
16:     vy: 0,
17:     speed: 4,
18:     jumpStrength: -12,
19:     onGround: true,
20:     color: '#0af'
21:   };
22: 
23:   // Obstacles (spikes) – simple rectangles moving left
24:   const spikes = [];
25:   let spawnTimer = 0;
26:   let speed = 3; // tunnel forward speed
27:   let speedInc = 0.001; // increase per frame
28:   let gameOver = false;
29: 
30:   const keys = {};
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
32:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
33: 
34:   function rectCollision(a, b) {
35:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
36:   }
37: 
38:   function spawnSpike() {
39:     // Generate a gap width between 80-150px, then place a spike covering the rest of the width
40:     const gapX = Math.random() * (W - 120) + 60; // centre of gap
41:     const gapW = 80 + Math.random() * 70;
42:     // left spike
43:     if (gapX - gapW / 2 > 0) {
44:       spikes.push({ x: W, y: 0, w: gapX - gapW / 2, h: H, color: '#f55' });
45:     }
46:     // right spike
47:     const rightX = gapX + gapW / 2;
48:     if (rightX < W) {
49:       spikes.push({ x: W, y: 0, w: W - rightX, h: H, color: '#f55' });
50:     }
51:   }
52: 
53:   function update(dt) {
54:     if (gameOver) return;
55:     // Player controls
56:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
57:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
58:     if ((keys.ArrowUp || keys.Space) && player.onGround) {
59:       player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
60:       player.onGround = false;
61:     }
62:     // gravity
63:     player.vy += 0.5; // gravity
64:     player.y += player.vy;
65:     // floor
66:     if (player.y + player.h >= H) {
67:       player.y = H - player.h;
68:       player.vy = 0;
69:       player.onGround = true;
70:     }
71:     // bounds
72:     if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
73:     if (player.x + player.w > W) player.x = W - player.w;
74: 
75:     // Move spikes left
76:     for (let i = spikes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
77:       const s = spikes[i];
78:       s.x -= speed;
79:       if (s.x + s.w < 0) spikes.splice(i, 1);
80:     }
81: 
82:     // Spawn logic
83:     spawnTimer -= dt;
84:     if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
85:       spawnSpike();
86:       spawnTimer = 1000; // ms until next gap
87:     }
88: 
89:     // Collision detection
90:     for (const s of spikes) {
91:       if (rectCollision(player, s)) {
92:         gameOver = true;
93:         break;
94:       }
95:     }
96: 
97:     // increase speed gradually
98:     speed += speedInc;
99:   }
100: 
101:   function draw() {
102:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
103:     // player
104:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
105:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
106:     // spikes
107:     for (const s of spikes) {
108:       ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
109:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.w, s.h);
110:     }
111:     if (gameOver) {
112:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
113:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
114:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
115:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
116:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
117:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
118:     }
119:   }
120: 
121:   let last = performance.now();
122:   function loop(now) {
123:     const dt = now - last;
124:     last = now;
125:     update(dt);
126:     draw();
127:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
128:   }
129: 
130:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
131: })();
